generations.name: First generation (X294)
generations.notes: Launch on EVA2, 400 V: 90.6 kWh usable, about 170 kW DC; AMG EQE SUV is a variant. EPA files the SUV under base model "EQE" with "(SUV)" in the label, so this model lists every SUV label (NRCan ends them with "SUV"). Confidence: medium-high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercedes-Benz_EQE_SUV

generations.name: 2025 update (96 kWh pack)
generations.notes: EQE 350+ SUV and 500 4MATIC SUV move to a 96 kWh pack; 350 4MATIC keeps 90.6 kWh; 2026 renames to 320. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://www.kbb.com/mercedes-benz/mercedes-eq-eqe-suv/2025/specs/ ; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercedes-Benz_EQE_SUV
